Qualcomm MSM8996 graphics clock controller

The graphics clocks share the MMCC register map. Describe the GPU controller
as a child of the MMCC controller so MMCC clocks can register before graphics
CPR, which supplies the GPU clock voltage domain.

Required properties:
- compatible: one of:
  - "qcom,gpucc-msm8996"
  - "qcom,gpucc-msm8996-v3", "qcom,gpucc-msm8996"
  - "qcom,gpucc-msm8996-pro", "qcom,gpucc-msm8996"
- #clock-cells: must be 1. IDs are defined in
  dt-bindings/clock/qcom,gpucc-msm8996.h.
- vdd_gfx-supply: graphics CPR corner regulator.
- vdd_mx-supply: memory corner regulator associated with graphics CPR.
- vdd_gpu_mx-supply: memory corner regulator for the graphics memory vote.
- qcom,gfxfreq-speedbin0: array of frequency (Hz), graphics corner and memory
  corner triplets. Corners are regulator voltage selectors, not microvolts.
- qcom,gfxfreq-mx-speedbin0: array of frequency (Hz) and memory corner pairs
  for the additional graphics memory vote.

Both tables must start with a zero frequency and zero corners, contain the
same frequencies in strictly increasing order and have nondecreasing corners.
Optional properties qcom,gfxfreq-speedbinN and qcom,gfxfreq-mx-speedbinN replace
the defaults for speed bin N. Both tables must exist for the selected bin;
otherwise bin 0 is used.

The parent MMCC must expose its speed-bin fuse as an "efuse" register resource.
For MSM8996 Pro the bin is bits 29:28; otherwise it is bits 31:29.
